task: Implement the M0-M2 foundation for explicit playbook outcome recording without changing candidate activation semantics.
outcome: After a candidate playbook is explicitly evaluated, the user can run lattice playbook_outcome_record and see: Playbook outcome recorded; outcome: helped|dismissed|harmful|neutral|unknown; authority: non_authoritative; gateEvidence: false.
facts: Existing playbook lifecycle commands are playbook_propose, playbook_diff, playbook_approve, playbook_activate, and playbook_reject.
playbook_approve creates candidate playbooks; playbook_activate is already the explicit activation boundary.
Learning data is stored under .lattice/learning/ via packages/main/src/core/learning-store.ts and resolves linked worktrees back to the main owner root.
Existing playbook commands are audit-only and must not satisfy DONE, review, release, or proof evidence gates.
The reviewed execution plan limits V1 to assessment/outcome ledger foundation and explicitly excludes automatic activation.
constraints: Do not add automatic candidate to active mutation.
Do not surface candidate playbooks in MemoryFreshnessPack.results.playbookIds or active runtime guidance.
Do not treat DONE success alone as helped outcome.
Keep command namespace host-neutral; no Codex- or Claude-specific playbook workflow command.
Only fix real correctness issues and keep the implementation consistent with existing playbook and learning-store patterns.
